Hardin County, Kentucky

Your Hardin County Epoxy Flooring Experts

Hardin County is home to more than 110,000 residents spread across Elizabethtown, Radcliff, Vine Grove, Fort Knox, and dozens of smaller communities. As a locally owned contractor, we serve all of them — with the same standards and the same warranty on every job, regardless of zip code.

Hardin County has unique flooring challenges driven by its geography and climate. Kentucky clay expands and contracts with moisture changes, which creates uplift pressure under slabs. The freeze-thaw cycles in winter can stress unprotected concrete. And the region's high humidity means moisture vapor transmission (MVT) is a real concern for any floor coating installation. We've built our process around these local realities: every job starts with a moisture meter reading, and we select products rated for Kentucky's specific MVT conditions.

Whether you're in a newer subdivision off Ring Road in Elizabethtown, an older farm property in the county's rural areas, or a commercial facility along US-31W, we have the experience, equipment, and products to give you a floor that looks great and lasts for decades.
